roles.name: erp_accountant
roles.label: Accountant
roles.description: Creates and sends invoices, marks them paid, reads accounts and contacts.

roles.name: ap_clerk
roles.label: Accounts Payable Clerk
roles.description: Manages vendor bills and outbound payments.

roles.name: asset_manager
roles.label: Asset Manager
roles.description: Manages fixed assets and maintenance orders.

roles.name: erp_admin
roles.label: ERP Administrator
roles.description: Full CRUD across every ERP domain — CRM, inventory, procurement, finance, and HR.

roles.name: controller
roles.label: Financial Controller
roles.description: Owns the general ledger — ledger accounts, journal entries, and posting.

roles.name: hr_manager
roles.label: HR Manager
roles.description: Manages departments, positions, employees, and leave requests (incl. PII).

roles.name: inventory_manager
roles.label: Inventory Manager
roles.description: Manages items, warehouses, stock levels, and stock movements.

roles.name: procurement_manager
roles.label: Procurement Manager
roles.description: Manages vendors and purchase orders, approves procurement, posts goods receipts.

roles.name: production_manager
roles.label: Production Manager
roles.description: Manages bills of materials and work orders on the shop floor.

roles.name: project_manager
roles.label: Project Manager
roles.description: Manages projects, tasks, and timesheets for services delivery.

roles.name: erp_viewer
roles.label: Read-only viewer
roles.description: Read-only access for auditors and observers.

roles.name: sales_manager
roles.label: Sales Manager
roles.description: Owns the sales pipeline — leads, opportunities, quotes, sales orders, and shipments.

roles.name: sales_rep
roles.label: Sales Representative
roles.description: Works leads, opportunities, and quotes; reads accounts and price lists.

roles.name: tax_manager
roles.label: Tax Manager
roles.description: Owns indirect-tax configuration and compliance — jurisdictions, country tax rules, and periodic VAT/GST/withholding returns.

roles.name: warehouse_clerk
roles.label: Warehouse Clerk
roles.description: Records stock movements and goods receipts; reads items and warehouses.
